_doc: A3.7e: diario de Dex, capítulo 5 y epílogo según la biblia (5.1–5.6 y E.1): respaldo, sillón, revelación, duelo final con PZ-BOT, Adrian tras el cristal, nota, salida y firma del NOW HIRING. Puzles en el orden de la ruta (Anon da la pista del último abierto). Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Find out who Patient Zero is.
Walk out of there. Sign something.

notes.text: Loaded the BACKUP floppy into the monitor. DO NOT LOSE. I didn't.
VOICE MATCH 100 %. Patient Zero is me. The case I couldn't crack.
PZ-BOT used the FUD Chad never used. I answered with the pool's comebacks. It shut down.
Anon is Adrian. Behind the glass, with a phone, the whole time.
Adrian's note: waiting, reading, asking. That's the cure. Gerald says hi.
Penny called. HR approved my hiring. Penny is HR.

hints: The doctor said yes. The door didn't. Heads up: the monitor in there reads wallets. Bring yours or don't. It works either way.
Two locks. You have a key from Adrian's office.
Bring the trading terminal key. Use the treatment door.
Read what the monitor is asking for.
It wants a backup. You've carried one since the basement.
Use the floppy disk on the monitor.
Patient must be seated. Guess who the patient is.
There's only one chair in that room.
Use the chair.
It's Chad's leftover FUD. You heard the answers at the pool.
Shallow end, deep end, the bar. The last answer is just the truth.
Streak of zero. They'll hear you lose. Receipts in the pool. I'm not you anymore.
Something is ringing. Not your phone.
Behind the broken glass.
Talk to the observation window.
I told you to read something.
The little table by the chair.
Pick up the note on the table.
You found what you came for. Now leave.
The door behind you.
Use the exit door.
Read the sign. It's practically begging.
Bring your own pen. You have a famous one.
Use the leaky pen on the NOW HIRING sign.

anonIdle: Go outside. Look at the sky. Just the sky.
